company.name: Reditus Space
company.shortDescription: Reditus Space specializes in microgravity manufacturing, offering reusable small-scale re-entry vehicles for space research and production.

productsAndServices.description: A reusable free-flying reentry spacecraft that transports payloads to low Earth orbit, supports in-space operations, and returns experiments or manufactured products to Earth.
productsAndServices.name: ENOS Spacecraft

productsAndServices.description: End-to-end services for preparing and delivering customer payloads to orbit, including payload and vehicle integration, launch coordination, licensing, and mission operations.
productsAndServices.name: Orbital Payload Launch and Integration Services

productsAndServices.description: In-orbit operation, monitoring, and management of the ENOS spacecraft and customer payloads during the planned mission duration.
productsAndServices.name: Autonomous Orbital Operations

productsAndServices.description: A service that performs controlled spacecraft reentry, pinpoint landing, and recovery of the ENOS vehicle and customer payloads for return to Earth.
productsAndServices.name: Controlled Reentry and Payload Recovery

productsAndServices.description: Access to microgravity for research and production processes involving crystal formation, drug formulation, optical communications materials, and semiconductor-related manufacturing.
productsAndServices.name: Microgravity Manufacturing Services

productsAndServices.description: Access to Mach 28-plus atmospheric reentry conditions for testing and refining aerospace and defense systems using real-world hypersonic flight data.
productsAndServices.name: High-Hypersonic Environment Testing
